sources.title: Rejection Sampling in Artificial Intelligence - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Rejection sampling generates random samples from a complex target distribution. It is useful when direct sampling from the target distribution is difficult or computationally expensive. The method relies on sampling from a simpler, more tractable proposal distribution and then applying a rejection criterion to ensure that the samples are consistent with the target distribution.
